map.EBIT 与净利润的关系？: Relationship between EBIT and net profit?
map.EBIT=净利润+利息费用+所得税；它排除了融资方式（利息）与税务安排的影响，专: EBIT = net profit + interest expense + income tax; it excludes the effects of financing (interest) and tax arrangements, focusing on operating-level profitability.
map.EBIT 和营业利润一样吗？: Is EBIT the same as operating profit?
map.口径接近但不完全相同：营业利润通常已扣公允价值变动、资产减值等，EBIT 更聚焦: The scope is close but not identical: operating profit usually already deducts fair-value changes and asset impairments, while EBIT focuses more on operating cash inflows/outflows; follow the figures as presented in the statements.
